tasks.name: Prepare the procurement plan and long-lead list
tasks.description: Plan each procurement package with sourcing route, durations and need dates, and identify long-lead items for early commitment.

needs.info: Contracting and procurement strategy: packages and owner/contractor-furnished split
Required-on-site dates per MR from the schedule
Equipment list with types, sizes and materials for lead-time assessment
Major electrical equipment list (transformers, switchgear, MCCs)
Control system and analyzer package scope

tasks.name: Prepare bidders lists and prequalify vendors
tasks.description: Select qualified bidders per package from the approved vendor list and prequalify new vendors.

needs.info: Owner approved manufacturers list and excluded vendors
Technical acceptability of proposed bidders per equipment type
Acceptable instrument and control system manufacturers
Acceptable electrical equipment manufacturers

tasks.name: Register material requisitions in the Purchasing DB
tasks.description: Log each MR and revision received through Document Locator, key header and line data and set status.

needs.info: Equipment MR: tags, quantity, datasheets, specifications, VDRL requirements, inspection level
Instrument MR: tag list, datasheets, quantities, specifications
Electrical MR: equipment tags, datasheets, quantities, specifications
Structural steel, building and civil material MRs
Required-on-site and need dates per MR

tasks.name: Load piping bulk MTO into the Purchasing DB
tasks.description: Import the S3D MTO spreadsheet, map commodity codes and add surplus allowances to form bulk MR lines.

needs.info: Piping MTO spreadsheet from S3D: commodity code, size, schedule, material, quantity per isometric and area
Piping material classes and valve/specialty item descriptions with short codes
Surplus allowance percentages by commodity

tasks.name: Issue RFQ packages
tasks.description: Combine the technical MR with commercial terms and issue the request for quotation to the bidders list.

needs.info: Registered MR and bidders list (SCM-T020, SCM-T030)
Commercial terms, contract templates and delivery terms from the procurement strategy
Vendor document numbering instructions and Document Locator submission rules

tasks.name: Manage bid clarifications and bid bulletins
tasks.description: Collect bidder questions, get technical answers and issue bid bulletins to all bidders.

needs.info: Bidder technical and commercial questions during the bid period
Technical answers to bidder questions and MR revisions
Technical answers to bidder questions on instrument packages
Technical answers to bidder questions on electrical packages

tasks.name: Receive bids and distribute technical portions
tasks.description: Open bids, separate priced and unpriced portions and send unpriced technical offers for technical bid evaluation.

needs.info: Technical quotation: compliance, deviations, datasheets, drawings, weights
Commercial quotation: prices, delivery, payment terms, validity

tasks.name: Prepare the commercial bid evaluation
tasks.description: Normalise prices, delivery and terms across bidders and score the commercial offers.

needs.info: Commercial quotation: price breakdown, options, spares pricing, delivery, terms exceptions
Technical bid evaluation: acceptable bidders, technical adders and deviations priced
Technical bid evaluation for instrument packages
Technical bid evaluation for electrical packages

tasks.name: Prepare the bid tabulation and award recommendation
tasks.description: Combine technical and commercial evaluations into the award recommendation for approval.

needs.info: Commercial bid evaluation (SCM-T080)
Technical bid evaluation recommendation
Budget per package from the control budget or estimate
Award approval for packages above the delegated authority

tasks.name: Award the purchase order in the Purchasing DB
tasks.description: Prepare the PO from the conformed MR and successful bid, enter PO header and lines and issue to the vendor.

needs.info: Approved award recommendation (SCM-T090)
Conformed MR for purchase incorporating agreed clarifications
Bulk MR line items with commodity codes and quantities
Cost codes and WBS for each PO line

tasks.name: Process PO amendments
tasks.description: Issue PO amendments for MR revisions, quantity changes and vendor change orders.

needs.info: MR revisions with changed scope or data
MTO revision deltas by commodity code
Vendor change order price and delivery impact
Approved change notice

tasks.name: Set up VDRL tracking
tasks.description: Load the vendor document requirements per PO with document numbers and due dates in the Purchasing DB.

needs.info: VDRL requirements in the MR: document types, review or information, due weeks after PO
Vendor document schedule with vendor document numbers and planned submission dates
Assigned project document numbers for vendor documents

tasks.name: Expedite vendor documents and route them for review
tasks.description: Receive vendor documents, transmit to engineering for review, return comments to the vendor and report print status.

needs.info: Vendor drawings and data for review with revision and transmittal
Vendor document review comments and review code
Nozzle load and orientation comments on vendor GAs
Foundation load and anchor bolt comments on vendor drawings
Instrument and control comments on package drawings and I/O
Electrical comments on motor and package electrical data
Consolidated comment sheet and review status

tasks.name: Expedite manufacturing and forecast deliveries
tasks.description: Track sub-orders, manufacturing milestones and forecast ex-works dates per PO line and report exceptions.

needs.info: Manufacturing schedule and progress reports with milestone dates
Required-on-site dates per PO line

tasks.name: Coordinate inspection and test plans
tasks.description: Review vendor ITPs, set hold and witness points with engineering and owner and assign inspectors.

needs.info: Inspection and test plan with hold/witness points
Inspection level and required tests per equipment item
Owner witness point selection

tasks.name: Carry out shop inspection and release
tasks.description: Witness tests, review certificates and issue inspection reports and release notes for shipment.

needs.info: Inspection notification with date and test
Material test reports, NDE records, hydrotest and performance test certificates
Certified vendor drawings and approved datasheets for dimensional checks
FAT procedure and acceptance criteria for control system and analyzer packages

tasks.name: Prepare the logistics plan
tasks.description: Plan freight routes, heavy-haul and oversize moves, customs and port handling.

needs.info: Shipping dimensions and weights for large equipment
Shipping envelope, weight and centre of gravity per shipping piece
Site access routes, laydown areas, heavy lift plan and set dates

tasks.name: Manage shipping and traffic
tasks.description: Book freight, clear customs and issue shipping notices to site.

needs.info: Packing list, shipping documents and preservation requirements
Inspection release note (SCM-T160)

tasks.name: Pass PO data to Jovix for receiving
tasks.description: Transfer PO header and line data to Jovix as expected receipts.

needs.info: PO header and PO line items in the Purchasing DB (SCM-T100, SCM-T110)

tasks.name: Receive materials at site in Jovix
tasks.description: Check received items against PO lines and packing lists, record heat numbers and tag them to location.

needs.info: Expected receipts and shipping notice (SCM-T180, SCM-T190)
Packing list with item marks, tags and heat numbers; MTRs

tasks.name: Raise OS&D reports
tasks.description: Report overage, shortage and damage on receipt and follow up with vendor and carrier.

needs.info: Receipt record discrepancies (SCM-T200)
Vendor response and replacement or repair proposal

tasks.name: Manage the warehouse, laydown and preservation
tasks.description: Store materials by location, perform periodic preservation and record it.

needs.info: Preservation and storage instructions per equipment item
Laydown area plan

tasks.name: Report material availability to AWP
tasks.description: Match received materials against CWP/IWP bills of material and publish availability for constraint checks.

needs.info: IWP bills of material and planned start dates
Isometric MTO per IWP (commodity codes, quantities)

tasks.name: Issue materials to construction
tasks.description: Reserve and issue materials against IWPs with pick tickets and record heat number traceability.

needs.info: Material requests and IWP release for issue

tasks.name: Reconcile materials and dispose of surplus
tasks.description: Reconcile ordered, received, issued and installed quantities and dispose of surplus.

needs.info: Installed quantities by commodity
Final IFC MTO totals

tasks.name: Call off vendor site services
tasks.description: Request vendor representatives for installation supervision and commissioning against PO service rates.

needs.info: Installation dates needing vendor supervision
Commissioning and startup dates needing vendor support

tasks.name: Procure commissioning and operating spares
tasks.description: Process vendor spare parts lists, get owner selection and place spares orders.

needs.info: Spare parts interchangeability records with part numbers and prices
Selected operating spares and quantities
Commissioning spares needs

tasks.name: Close out purchase orders
tasks.description: Confirm final documentation, MDR and deliveries complete and close POs.

needs.info: Final MDR/data book accepted
Final receipts and OS&D closed (SCM-T200, SCM-T210)
Final invoice and back-charge status

items.name: Procurement plan
items.content: Packages, sourcing route, procurement durations, RFQ/award dates and ROS per MR.

items.name: Long-lead items list
items.content: Tag, description, lead time, ROS and required commitment date for long-lead items.

items.name: Bidders list
items.content: Approved bidders per MR with contact and qualification status.

items.name: Vendor prequalification record
items.content: Capability, capacity, quality system and financial assessment of new vendors.

items.name: MR register entry
items.content: MR number, revision, title, originator, tag list, status and need date.

items.name: Bulk material MR lines
items.content: Commodity code, description, size, material, quantity with surplus allowance, area.

items.name: RFQ package
items.content: MR, commercial terms, instructions to bidders, VDRL, bid due date.

items.name: Bid bulletin
items.content: Questions and answers and MR changes issued to all bidders.

items.name: Unpriced technical offers for TBE
items.content: Technical portions of each bid sent to the technical evaluator with TBE due date.

items.name: Commercial bid evaluation
items.content: Normalised price, delivery, terms and commercial ranking per bidder.

items.name: Award recommendation
items.content: Recommended vendor, evaluated price, delivery and justification, with approvals.

items.name: Purchase order
items.content: Issued PO document: scope, conformed MR, price, delivery, terms, VDRL.

items.name: PO header data
items.content: PO number, vendor, award date, value, delivery terms, buyer, expeditor.

items.name: PO line items
items.content: Line number, tag or commodity code, description, quantity, unit price, contract delivery date, cost code.

items.name: PO amendment
items.content: Amendment number, changed lines, quantities, price and delivery changes.

items.name: VDRL tracking records
items.content: Per PO: vendor document number, project number, type, review/information, due date.

items.name: Vendor print status report
items.content: Per vendor document: due, received, sent for review, returned, review code, overdue days.

items.name: Vendor documents routed for review
items.content: Vendor drawings and data transmitted to reviewing disciplines with return date.

items.name: Review comments returned to vendor
items.content: Consolidated comments and review code returned to the vendor by transmittal.

items.name: Expediting forecast
items.content: Per PO line: milestone status, forecast ex-works and site delivery dates, exceptions.

items.name: Inspection assignment and agreed ITP
items.content: Inspection level, hold/witness points agreed, inspector assigned per PO.

items.name: Inspection report
items.content: Tests witnessed, results, non-conformances and open points.

items.name: Inspection release note
items.content: Release for shipment per PO line with outstanding items listed.

items.name: Logistics plan
items.content: Routes, heavy-haul and oversize moves, port and customs plan, transport schedule.

items.name: Shipping notice
items.content: PO, shipping pieces, weights, dimensions, carrier and expected arrival date at site.

items.name: Expected receipts in Jovix
items.content: PO number and lines, quantities and descriptions passed from the Purchasing DB for receiving.

items.name: Material receipt record
items.content: PO line received, quantity, date, location, heat numbers and MTR reference, tag.

items.name: OS&D report
items.content: Overage, shortage and damage details, photos, PO line and disposition.

items.name: Storage location and preservation records
items.content: Item location and preservation activity dates and findings.

items.name: Material availability status
items.content: Material availability per IWP fed to iConstruct for constraint checks.

items.name: Material issue record
items.content: Pick ticket, IWP, items and quantities issued with heat numbers.

items.name: Material shortage report
items.content: Shortages per IWP with expected receipt dates.

items.name: Material reconciliation and surplus report
items.content: Ordered vs received vs issued vs installed by commodity, surplus disposal.

items.name: Vendor site service request
items.content: Service type, dates, location and PO reference for vendor representatives.

items.name: Spares purchase order and register
items.content: Spare parts ordered by tag and part number, quantities, delivery.

items.name: PO close-out record
items.content: Final documentation, deliveries and claims complete, PO closed date.

items.name: Committed cost data
items.content: PO and amendment values by cost code and WBS for cost reporting.
